svg.text: PG-1 wiring 2/10: Carrier board -> Seed3: the 6 signal jumpers
Plug these onto the board's header BEFORE the board goes in the box (the names are printed on the board). Their other ends go into the Seed3
Seed3 socket: the jumper-end block in the right wall, from INSIDE (USB-C end on your left)
Steps (the number is on the wire)
